answer: Concrete mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. The beacon words fit the design: whisper stands for the transparency that makes every pattern visible, nebula captures the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation, and grove mirrors the random sampling that seats juries. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture. The design makes attack a purchase with a visible invoice.
